form.message: Architecture approval and continuation are recorded. One routing choice remains: include the optional Design step or proceed to Governance. For this MVP, a rendered architecture diagram alone is a proportionate option. ADRs are optional decision records, not additional infrastructure. No service, SKU, cost or security choice is being repeated.

optional_design_scope.title: After Architecture — optional Design artifacts
optional_design_scope.description: Choose the next authorized owner and scope. Design produces documentation only; Governance still requires actual target evidence through its separate scope and approval process. No option authorizes Azure operations or bypasses tenant verification.
enumNames: Include Design: architecture diagram and ADRs (04-Design)
Skip optional Design; continue to Governance (04g-Governance)
